description:
Use this when the user asks about daily FII transaction flow in one Indian stock in the historical CDSL data, which stops at March 2025.

Returns a daily series of FII/FPI buy, sell and net for one stock from CDSL's disclosures, with a 30-day summary. The data covers CDSL only and ends in March 2025, so it is a partial, historical view. `days` (1 to 1825, default 90) is the length of the series, counted back from the latest day of data held for the stock, not from today; `effective_from` and `effective_to` give the dates covered. For current flow use get_market_fii_dii_flow (whole market) or get_sector_fpi_investment (by sector); for holding percentages, get_shareholding.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_stock_fii_flow
title: Stock FII flow (historical)
